text.p: Second seed Arantxa Sanchez Vicario was unexpectedly beaten 6-3 7-6 by unseeded Helena Sukova in the Leipzig tournament quarter-finals on Friday.
The Spaniard's defeat leaves top seed Steffi Graf the clear favourite in the $450,000 women's event.
Sanchez seemed to have difficulty concentrating on her game while her Czech opponent produced excellent serves and volleys, securing the first set with relative ease.
Sukova played the second set with a strong forehand and launched brilliantly-timed attacks from the net.
The Czech's semifinal opponent on Saturday will be the winner of Friday's other quarter-final between American Lindsay Davenport, the number five seed, and third seed Iva Majoli of Croatia.
Top seed Graf faces German compatriot Anke Huber, the fourth seed, in the semifinals.
"Of course Steffi is the favourite," Huber said, "but that doesn't mean the outcome of the game is a foregone conclusion. I think I have a good chance of winning."
